Nothing's on your calendar for Sunday, so the afternoon is open. It should be a nice day too, around 27 and mostly dry.

Markham Museum has a "Sunday drop-in at the museum" on Sunday afternoon, for ages 6-12, which fits Lin. That's from their own site, which didn't list a price or exact hours, so I haven't confirmed either. [link-e88d48]

Do you want me to put it on Sunday's calendar?
